name: Archived F2 sculpted central-cell study
description: Archived and withdrawn as the current reconstruction baseline on 6 November 2026. F2 generated free floor and sill profiles without binding them to the original body-dimension network. The retained curved central-cell geometry and diagnostic media document this rejected assumption study; they do not represent a corrected donor reconstruction, measured fitment or a commercial monocoque copy.

known_limits: Archived and withdrawn as the current reconstruction baseline: original body-control observations were not bound to generated F2 features. The dimensional-correction packet records zero implemented source/model comparisons, and intrinsic nonplanarity checks reject the examined floor and underside regions. Frozen F2 source, results and images remain historical diagnostics.

Structural shapes, wall thicknesses, material properties, module reservations, fixture regions, the common ground datum and axle-X placement are authored assumptions. Brochure width/height, wheelbase, track and tyre-size nominals are documentary constraints, not measured donor interfaces.
The design frame is independent; no donor transform, dimensional accuracy or 993/Carrera 4 compatibility is admitted. Model-year bounds identify study scope only.

The current raw native mesh failed its quality screen: 36 collapsed, exactly zero-area faces are retained without filtering or repair. Published native views are unqualified diagnostics; source CAD/profile and transport checks do not admit native mesh quality.
Native wall artifacts are retained privately. Public source and image receipts bind their hashes; the catalogue images are geometry renders, not photographs or a manufactured specimen.
Any accompanying STEP consists of editable midsurfaces only and does not establish a physical wall solid. Native voxel geometry has separate resolution and topology limits.

Wheel cylinders use nominal brochure tracks and tyre markings; front/rear module boxes remain assumed static reservations. Actual modules, loaded tyre geometry, steering, suspension motion, transmission linkage, attachments and tolerance stacks remain unqualified.
Visible load-path members and numerical stiffness do not establish laminate strength, bond/insert capacity, buckling, fatigue, crash, occupant restraint, fire or aging performance.
Laminate/core/adhesive allowables, manufacturing route, tooling, drape/cure, inspection, physical correlation and professional road/track/TUV approval remain open.
The earlier F1 assumption study and withdrawn whole-body geometry remain separate; their calculations or renders do not qualify this design.
No measured mass or superiority over a commercial monocoque is established. This concept is not a released functional part or a validated final digital twin.
